lines: It was a few days after I had been appointed as captain of the Taimanin Independent Commando Unit.
I was like a new man, studying zealously and working up a sweat in trainingー
Just kidding, I was still living the same aimless school life that I had been up until now.
I awoke from my slumber to a familiar voice.
Please stop fooling around and get up.
Against a backdrop of gentle sunlight, Tokiko was peering at me.
Your afternoon classes already began ages ago.
English class? Taimanin don't need English.
I'm now the captain of the Independent Commando Unit. No matter how many classes I skip, I won't be expelled. That's one of the perks, Tokiko.
There were many students who went on missions as Taimanin while attending school.
Those students would not get expelled even if their attendance was lacking.
You won't be expelled, but you may have to repeat a year... It's uncool to be the captain who remains a student forever.
That means Hebiko and Shikanosuke would become my senpai. That definitely wouldn't be great...
...Okay, I'll try to attend classes. So what's up? Did you need something from me?
Yes. Take a look at these. They are letters for you.
Yes, they are requests made to the newly established Independent Commando Unit.
I slowly got up and took the stack of letters from Tokiko.
I read the first few lettersー
"It seems like ghosts are haunting the nearby castle ruins. Please investigate." "Someone has been breaking tons of windows as a prank. Catch the culprit."
"My girlfriend doesn't trust me anymore so I'm running away. Don't come looking for me."
What the hell are these... Do they think I do odd jobs?
It just shows how much attention you are getting.
Heh, Tokiko, you look happy about it.
Of course I'm happy! My master is getting so much attention...!
(I'm not exactly pleased with the kind of attention they're giving, though...)
So that's what you needed to tell me?
Of course not only the letters! Headmistress Asagi also has a direct order for you!
(Maybe it really is something to be happy about...)
People kept calling me "Diot," and I've always been treated like a failure.
And now Igawa Asagi, the Taimanin Chief Commander, had acknowledged my efforts and was giving me direct orders. It still felt like a dream.
She said, "Come to the headmistress's office at 15:00." You absolutely cannot be late!
(Oh well, I guess it's not so bad.)
At any rate, seeing Tokiko happy didn't put me in a bad moodー
"Tokyo Kingdom," the abandoned city floating in Tokyo Bayー
The man-made island about half the size of Sakurajima was once a major project of the government called "Tokyo Kingdom City."
It had been expected to be a second city center for Tokyo, where the population had been increasing steadily. ーHowever...
Attempts to attract businesses failed, and construction of the Tokyo Bay Subway was delayed, making it an isolated island with inconvenient transportation, so residents left one after another.
And then, before anyone knew it, smugglers, criminals, anarchists, and all sorts of demons had started to move in...
At present, it had become a major slum of pleasure and decadence.
The air was warm and humid, and the stench of garbage and spicesーas well as the unadulterated scent of sexーlingered in the air.
This was the downtown area of Tokyo Kingdom.
I had... I mean, we had set foot on this island after receiving direct orders from Headmistress Asagi.
(Hmm... so this is Tokyo Kingdom, one of the most infamous Cities of Darkness in Japan...)
Once a City of Darkness formed, women with nowhere else to go would also turn up, following the scent of money that gathered there.
The downtown area we were in had now become famous as Japan's, no, Asia's mecca of debauchery.
(Back in the old days, I'd be old enough to get married. I would like to have a bit of fun with the ladies though...)
There should be time. I had also received quite a bit of money to prepare for the mission.
I glanced at my companion walking next to me.
(Nah... I should behave myself for now...)
Ooh, is that an Oni? First time I've seen one...
And those prostitutes over there are Succubi? They really are something to look at. Is that a centaur!? So many different beings from the Devildom...
Don't look around like that. You'll attract attention.
Murasaki-sensei...! But there are all these demi-humans walking around that I've only seen in books so far!
Ooh, what's that...? That's some crazy armor...
Good grief, we aren't here on vacation. This is Tokyo Kingdom. Be sure to keep a low profile.
(Are you really the right person to be telling me that!?)
...Is what I had wanted to say, but I managed to keep my mouth shut.
Yes, the one accompanying me on this mission was Yatsu Murasaki-sensei. She was a Taimanin famous for her bravery, and also a teacher at Gosha Academy.
She was honest, with a strong sense of justice, overwhelming strength, and unparalleled beauty. She was admired by the students at Gosha Academy.
(She really is a tough one to deal with. You could say she throws me out of whack...)
The woman standing before me was a beauty with an alluring figure.
But in spite of that, it was almost like the oppositeーI felt a sense of intimidation as though a muscular gym teacher were standing before me.
Um... Murasaki-sensei, I have a question.
Why did you pick me for this mission?
This was the first mission for the newly formed Independent Commando Unit, appointed by Igawa Asagi.
It was to cooperate with Taimanin Yatsu Murasaki to infiltrate Tokyo Kingdom and bring back the demonologist Kiryu Sabato, who was on the run.
And Murasaki-sensei had picked me to go with her. It was quite a surprising choice. Tokiko had been as happy as if she herself had gotten picked.
Even though we were called the Independent Commando Unit, it wasn't like we had any achievements as of yet. So why did she choose me?
I heard from Asagi-sama about your actions during the rebellion. You quickly noticed that the chaotic battle was just a diversion and ran to protect Asagi-sama faster than anyone else.
I think... Headmistress Asagi would have been fine even without my help.
(And the real reason I went to the headmistress's office was to stop Gaiza...)
Of course. Asagi-sama wouldn't be defeated by the likes of Fürst or the greenhorn Nisha Gaiza!
Murasaki-sensei's face became flushed as she talked about Asagi-sensei.
It's important that you saw through the enemies' plans. I'm counting on that brain of yours.
No, not at all! It's an honor, thank you very much.
I held back the urge to say "Yes ma'am!" but still thought that her choice was a bit surprising.
Murasaki-sensei's Ninja Art was an Exelemental Ninja Art called "Immortal Awakening."
It gave her the superhuman body of a nearly immortal being and the godlike strength to match it.
She was your typical heavy hitter, said to be strong enough to destroy the armor of a tank.
Of course she was well aware of her own abilities and preferred tactics that allowed her to utilize that brute strength.
And now someone like her was counting on my "brain."
(Maybe she's actually not a Taimanin who's only focused on power...)
Fuma, I know you are analyzing me right now.
Ah... I'm sorry. It's a habit.
It doesn't bother me. Analyzing is your job.
Murasaki-sensei said no more and resumed scanning our surroundings.
Ah, while we're at it, there was something I wanted to ask about...
About this mission. I heard Kiryu didn't switch sides to Nomad...
But according to these documents, Kiryu is a former Nomad demonologist. Wouldn't it make sense for him to return back to Nomad...?
He had noticed that Muroi was actually Fürst. So the question of why he didn't report that turned into a problem at a meeting...
I-I was a bit too harsh, and he ran away sulking!
I had read about Kiryu Sabato in the documents I had received before the mission.
He was a demonologist that used to work with Nomad, but Murasaki-sensei had captured him, and now he was living in the basement of Gosha Academy.
He had become an important asset, sharing his knowledge in Devildom medicine and surgical practices with the Taimanin, and helping with the treatment of demonic toxins and wounds.
Someone like him, a demonologist who excels in not only medicine, but also in modifications and enhancements, is going to be sought after by everyone.
If he fell into anyone else's hands, he would be an extraordinary threat.
I'm rather surprised he has cooperated with us until now.
Murasaki-sensei looked like she was sucking on a lemon as I spoke.
Anyway, we can't just let him roam free. If the government finds out, they'll put a hit out on him...
So you don't want to kill him then?
More importantly, are you investigating the area Kiryu is hiding in?
Y-Yes! I've dispatched members of the Independent Commando Unit in advance to infiltrate the area and investigate. We should be able to get some information when we regroup.
Have you already found Kiryu's hiding spot?
No, not yet... First of all, I had them investigate if there was any place in this town where we could gather information.
Hmm. When in Rome, do as the Romans do? Then I'll leave you to deal with locating Kiryu.
From here on we'll act separately. I have another mission to deal with. Be careful when dealing Kiryu Sabato, got it?
That guy is the opposite of what you would call righteous and is rotten to the core.
Is it alright to let someone like him to be a demonologist that treats Taimanin...?
You won't be able to deal with him by ordinary means, even if you can find him. His character is completely tainted by evil.
It was a harsh way to put it.
In case you ever have trouble dealing with him, use this.
Murasaki-sensei held out a single envelope. On the back side it was tightly sealed with wax.
(Some kind of... important document? Maybe some information Kiryu wants...)
Listen, absolutely never open it. If you open it, Fuma, I'll have to kill you.
Very well. I wish you luck.
Murasaki-sensei left me with those words and simply disappeared into the darkness.
I was left behind alone in an alleyway in the City of Darkness. In my hand, a single thin envelope.
"Open it and I'll kill you"... Wh-What the hell is in here...?
I hate to say it, but...
The agents who had infiltrated Tokyo Kingdom in advanceーHebiko and Shikanosukeーwere completely lost.
Hey, Shikanosuke-chan!! Stop making a fuss!! You'll attract attention!
But, but!! We're lost in a city full of villaaaaaaaains!?
Shikanosuke complained in a tearful voice. After walking around blindly, they no longer even knew which direction they had come from.
Hebiko told you you're too loud! This is a dangerous neighborhood!!
What should we dooooo?! We have to quickly regroup with Fumaaaa!!
Dear, oh dear~ Are you two in trouble?? Do you want this nice guy to help you??
A dangerous-looking gangster had called out to them. They both replied immediately and quickly tried to leave.
No need to be shy~ Look how cute you are~
He must have been on drugs or something. The man stared at them with wide, lifeless eyes and came closer.
H-Hey! He seems to like you, Hebiko! He thinks you're cute!! Go get him!!
Kyaaah─!! Hey!? Don't push Hebiko, you traitor─!!!
L-Look at his eyes! Those are the eyes of a murderer!!! Maybe even the eyes of a murderer who eats his victims!? Please let us go!!!
Th-Then why are you pushing Hebiko towards him!?
The two of them were squabbling in front of the wide-eyed gangster.
What's going on? Are you picking fights again?
From the back, an equally dangerous-looking gangster girl appeared.
Whoa, big sis!!! There's a kid that you'll love right here~ You already used up the previous kid, didn't you?!
Sh-Shikanosuke!! You're her type!!! Go, go!!!
Whoa!? Stupid! Don't push me, you stupid!!!
The tables were turned, and this time Hebiko was pushing Shikanosuke forward.
The woman's deep red nails reached for the both of themー
She's somewhat lacking in sex appeal, but she has nice titties♪
Her fingers were prodding Hebiko's breasts.
What a lovely shape♪ I really want to squash them♪
Shikanosuke was watching Hebiko and the gangster girl chase each other in circles with a distant look in his eyes.
Hebiko... I will never forget your sacrifice...!!
But he too was being pursued by an evil entityーright behind him.
Me tooooo!? Stooop!! Don't touch my buuuuuuutt!!!
The pitiful screams of the two echoed through the skies of Tokyo Kingdom.
